where: crates/blaze-sim (Config) vs blaze-cas, blaze-solo, blaze-hub test modules
what: blaze_sim::Config collides with the crate under test own Config (the store config in blaze-cas tests, run::Config in blaze-solo, crate::Config in blaze-hub), so every port imports it as `Config as SimConfig`; a name like blaze_sim::Cases or Search would not collide
